description: Scrape YouTube videos and Shorts by hashtag. Provide one or more hashtags to extract all tagged videos including views, channel info, publish time, and more.

contentType.description: Which type of content to collect from the hashtag page.
contentType.title: Content Type

hashtags.description: List of hashtags to scrape. You can include or omit the # prefix — both formats are accepted (e.g. '#programming' or 'programming').
hashtags.title: Hashtags

market.description: Country/region for localized results. Sets the gl and hl URL parameters to return regionally relevant content.
market.title: Market / Region

maxResultsPerHashtag.description: Maximum number of videos to return per hashtag. Includes both regular videos and Shorts when content type is 'All'.
maxResultsPerHashtag.title: Max Results Per Hashtag

title: YouTube Hashtag Scraper Input
